questions.text: Do grid labels (numbers/letters) match between Architectural, Structural, MEP and Civil drawings?
Do grid-to-grid dimensions match between Architectural and Structural plans?
Do the overall dimensions (sum of grid spacings) match the overall building dimension on every sheet?
Are any grid lines shown on one discipline but missing on another?
Are there duplicate grid tags, or skipped tags that suggest a deleted grid?
For skewed or radial grids, are the angle, radius and center point dimensioned?
Are partial/secondary grids (e.g. A.1, 3.5) dimensioned to a primary grid?
Do enlarged plans and sections use the same grid labels and spacing as the overall plans?
Is the building tied to the site by grid-intersection coordinates or dimensions to property lines on Civil?
Are any grid bubbles missing at one end, making grid identification ambiguous?
Does the Architectural FFE match the Structural top-of-slab elevation for each level?
Is the relationship between project 0'-0" (or 100'-0") and actual sea-level/survey elevation stated?
Are level names and elevations identical on plans, sections, elevations and schedules?
Do floor-to-floor heights shown on Architectural sections match Structural?
Are top-of-footing, top-of-wall, top-of-pier and top-of-steel elevations given wherever required?
Do slab elevations account for floor finishes, toppings or depressions shown on Architectural?
Are elevations given relative to a level (e.g. -1'-4") clearly defined as relative or absolute?
Does the Civil finished grade at the building perimeter work with the slab and footing elevations?
Is a benchmark identified, with its elevation and location?
Are building corner coordinates (northing/easting) provided and consistent with the grid layout?
Does the building footprint and rotation on Civil match the Architectural/Structural plans?
Is project elevation 0'-0" (or 100'-0") correlated to the Civil vertical datum?
Are setbacks to property lines dimensioned and consistent between Civil and Architectural?
Is the coordinate system (state plane, local) and units stated?
Is a compressive strength (f'c) specified for every concrete element on the drawings?
Does the strength in the Structural general notes match the specification Division 03?
Are exposure classes (freeze-thaw, sulfate, chloride, water) assigned for exterior, below-grade and parking elements?
Does the geotechnical report call for sulfate-resistant cement or other requirements not reflected in the notes?
Are max w/c ratio, air entrainment and aggregate size specified per element?
Is it clear which elements are lightweight vs normal-weight concrete?
Are fly ash/slag limits, admixtures or special mixes (SCC, high early strength) addressed?
Are any elements on plans not listed in the mix schedule (e.g. pads, curbs, toppings, site concrete)?
Is the testing age (28/56/90 days) specified, especially for high-strength or mass concrete?
Is the reinforcing steel grade (e.g. Grade 60/80, Fe500) specified, and is it consistent with specs?
Is clear cover specified for each condition (cast against earth, exposed to weather, interior)?
Does the lap splice table cover every bar size used on the project?
Are Class A vs Class B splice requirements and top-bar factors clear?
Are standard hook and development length requirements provided?
Is epoxy-coated, galvanized or stainless reinforcing required anywhere, and is the extent defined?
Are welded wire reinforcement sizes and lap requirements specified?
Are mechanical couplers allowed/required, and where?
Do typical rebar notes conflict with any specific details?
Are expansion/seismic joints shown at the same locations on Architectural and Structural plans?
Is the joint width specified and consistent?
Does each joint continue through foundations, slabs, walls, roof and facade consistently?
Are joint cover assemblies specified at floors, walls, roofs and ceilings?
Are double columns/walls or slide bearings detailed at each joint?
Do MEP systems crossing the joint have flexible connections shown?
Does every referenced typical detail exist on the referenced sheet?

questions.text: Does the geotechnical report require a mud mat that is not shown on Structural drawings?
Is mud mat thickness and extent beyond footing/mat specified?
Is the mud mat concrete strength specified?
Is the bottom of structural concrete above or below the mud mat clearly defined?
Is waterproofing placed on top of the mud mat, and is that detail shown?
Is a vapor retarder shown under all interior slabs-on-grade?
Is the thickness/class (e.g. 10 mil vs 15 mil, ASTM E1745 Class A) consistent between drawings and specs?
Is the vapor retarder placed directly under the slab or under a granular blotter layer, and do Arch and Struct agree?
Are vapor retarder details at slab edges, penetrations and thickenings provided?
Is vapor retarder required under elevator pits, mats or turndowns?
Is under-slab or perimeter insulation required by energy code but missing from Structural sections?
Is insulation thickness, R-value and extent (e.g. 2'-0" in from perimeter) specified?
Is the insulation thickness accounted for in footing/slab elevations?
Do Arch and Struct sections show the same insulation location (vertical vs horizontal)?
Is insulation compressive strength adequate under loaded slabs?
Is the base course thickness the same in Geotech, Struct and Arch sections?
Is the base material gradation specified?
